content.text:
The change is complete and the test suite is green.

I made a single, self-contained change to `BusinessDays.java` (one file, low structural impact):

- Added a private `HOLIDAYS` set with the five pinned dates.
- Added a tiny `isBusinessDay` helper (CC 1).
- Rewrote `toBusinessDay` as a simple loop that rolls forward off weekends **and** holidays — this also correctly handles the case where a weekend roll lands on a holiday (e.g. Sat → Mon holiday → Tue).

Both callers (`OwnerMapper.effectiveRegistrationDate` and the daily-limit/bulk-signup advices) pick up the new behavior automatically since they all route through `BusinessDays.toBusinessDay`, so no other files needed touching. `BUILD SUCCESS`, all tests pass.

The change is complete and the test suite is green.

I made a single, self-contained change to `BusinessDays.java` (one file, low structural impact):

- Added a private `HOLIDAYS` set with the five pinned dates.
- Added a tiny `isBusinessDay` helper (CC 1).
- Rewrote `toBusinessDay` as a simple loop that rolls forward off weekends **and** holidays — this also correctly handles the case where a weekend roll lands on a holiday (e.g. Sat → Mon holiday → Tue).

Both callers (`OwnerMapper.effectiveRegistrationDate` and the daily-limit/bulk-signup advices) pick up the new behavior automatically since they all route through `BusinessDays.toBusinessDay`, so no other files needed touching. `BUILD SUCCESS`, all tests pass.
